summary: TRACK 25.01 AOS Phase B+C E2E verified. All 8 legacy admin routes render LegacyMovedBanner with correct canonical mappings + reasons + data-testids. All 9 legacy routes return 200 (zero routes deleted). Banner CTA navigates to /admin/operations-control?highlight=<op-id>; target card gains data-occ-highlighted=true + amber ring (border-amber-500 ring-4 ring-amber-200) and is scrolled into view. All 4 Phase C ops rendered (deploy.readiness_check, deploy.recovery_playbook, integrations.probe_all, queues.scheduler_runs) among 14 total OCC cards with populated status_snapshots (warning/warning/warning/healthy — not `unavailable`). Dismiss hides banner for current session, persists across reload (sessionStorage key `masci.aos.banner.dismissed:<path>`=1), and returns on sessionStorage clear (fresh-session simulation). Backend regression: /api/admin/operations-control/overview returns 14 ops incl. all 4 Phase C; /api/admin/deploy-readiness=200; /api/admin/scheduler-runs=200; /api/admin/integrations/health=200.

minor.issue: Path in test brief returns 404. Actual working endpoint is /api/admin/integrations/health (200). Only a doc/naming nit — underlying integration-health functionality is intact and OCC integrations.probe_all card is populated.

integration_issues.issue: CTA click via Playwright programmatic .click() requires ~2s post-mount settle before onClick fires reliably. Real-user clicks after page settled work fine. Likely React hydration + StrictMode double-mount effect timing, not a functional bug.

action_items: OPTIONAL: If test-brief accuracy matters, update the Track 25.01 spec doc to reference /api/admin/integrations/health (existing route) instead of /api/admin/integration-health/probes.

legacyRedirects.js is a pure static map with helpers — good separation.
OperationsControlCenter deep-link highlight logic verified: card gets border-amber-500 + ring-4 ring-amber-200 + data-occ-highlighted=true with transition-all duration-500 (smooth pulse-in).
